svg.title: Moscow section 01 — first four route ways, approximately 2,061 m
svg.desc: North-up schematic from createMoscowNetwork runtime road surfaces. Grey full carriageways, orange selected route. OSM layout / reference review, not surveyed. No satellite tracing. Road widths use runtime lane and shoulder assumptions; heights are not depicted.
svg.text: First four directed route ways · 0–2,061 m (source chainage, rounded)
OSM layout / reference review, not surveyed
Same metre scale on both axes.
Grey context is clipped to the crop;
Inset only: 16 px/m, not the map scale.
Lane evidence does not measure width.
Not satellite traced or a map editor.
Reproduce: npx tsx scripts/render-moscow-section.ts · geometry and current manual edits are read, never modified.
